newsitem.title: USA: Centennial Technologies dismisses CFO for cause.
newsitem.headline: Centennial Technologies dismisses CFO for cause.

text.p: Centennial Technologies Inc, which is preparing to restate its results for the past three years amid allegations of wrongdoing by senior company officials, has dismissed its chief financial officer, a spokeswoman said on Thursday.

James Murphy -- suspended from his job as CFO when Emanuel Pinez was ousted as chief executive -- was dismissed by the Billerica-based personal computer card maker on Wednesday for cause, spokeswoman Cheryl Byrne said.
"In light of recent events, this letter will confirm that your employment by Centennial Technologies Inc has been terminated for cause," read the letter sent to Murphy, the spokeswoman said.
Murphy has said he is being made a scapegoat for the company's difficulties.
Shares in Centennial, delisted earlier this month by the New York Stock Exchange and allowed to trade on the NASD pink sheets for a single day, are no longer being traded, Byrne said.

At the time of its delisting, the company's auditors, Coopers & Lybrand, said it would take six to 10 weeks before a restatement of Centennial's financial reports for the past three years could be completed.
Meanwhile, a series of class-action lawsuits by both shareholders and options traders have been filed against the company in the federal court in Boston.
